_comment: One class constructor writes `this.value` at two `new` sites; the instance holding plain data is compared structurally, the one holding the service reads one method. Under the class rule (a service that reaches class code bails its key; class code is every class body that is not a key class, and every function nested in one) the constructor's parameter holds the service, so every method stays, including the unread one, and the bundle runs.
